n, b = map(int, input().split())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
bal = [0] * n

for i in range(n):
    if i == 0:
        bal[i] = 1 if a[i] % 2 == 0 else -1
    else:
        bal[i] = bal[i - 1] + (1 if a[i] % 2 == 0 else -1)

pq = []
for i in range(1, n - 1):
    if bal[i] == 0:
        pq.append(abs(a[i + 1] - a[i]))

import heapq
heapq.heapify(pq)

ans = 0
while pq and b >= pq[0]:
    b -= heapq.heappop(pq)
    ans += 1

print(ans)
